analysis:
Both units are base-side text of docs/reference/protocol-messages.md. The PR changes only documentation: the 'Last updated' date (line 3) and the GLM native prompt contract table (base lines 1147 and 1149-1153; head 1147 and 1149-1155). The visible patch excerpt is truncated. It shows that the reasoning.effort row now documents null `reasoning` as unset and `reasoning.summary` / `reasoning.generate_summary` (auto/concise/detailed) as no-ops, with other `reasoning` members still refused. No code, wire message, key handling, authorization, attestation, cache or billing change is visible.

The documented change is a prompt-policy input-validation relaxation in GLM5NextPromptPolicy (RawControls). It is limited to accepting a few benign no-op keys and keeps the fail-closed rejection of unknown `reasoning` members. It adds no new trust grant, in line with the statement that GLM adds no trusted caller field. This touches TB-002 (request body decoded after E2E decryption) and TB-007 only in prose. T-008 and T-041 are unaffected, and the visible text does not alter encryption or cache scoping.

The Swift implementation is not supplied, so I cannot verify that the code matches the docs. Specifically, I cannot check that null and summary handling does not bypass the rejection of other reasoning keys or the thinking-off conflict checks, and I cannot see the remaining rows (1150-1155). The text of unchanged units 4 and 5 (e.g. the prefix cache receipts and models_replace sections) is pre-existing and was not re-evaluated. The next pass should confirm the code in GLM5NextPromptPolicy.swift matches the documented validation, including that the summary values are not forwarded into the rendered prompt context.
